name: Befrienders Worldwide
summary: Global directory connecting to emotional support services in over 30 countries worldwide.

sections.title: About Befrienders Worldwide
sections.text: Befrienders Worldwide is an international organization connecting people in emotional distress with crisis support services around the globe. Founded in 1974, Befrienders Worldwide coordinates a network of emotional support centers in over 30 countries across Africa, the Americas, Asia, Australia, Europe, and the Middle East. The organization provides a vital directory service helping people anywhere in the world find local crisis support in their language and time zone.

sections.title: Finding Help Worldwide
sections.text: The Befrienders Worldwide website maintains a directory of crisis support services organized by country and region. Each listing includes contact information, hours of operation, and available services. Whether you're in Argentina, Bangladesh, Japan, Nigeria, Sweden, or anywhere else, the directory can help you find local support. This makes Befrienders Worldwide an essential resource for travelers, expatriates, or anyone seeking help in a country other than their home.

sections.title: Emotional Support Services
sections.text: Member centers provide emotional support to anyone in distress, not only those who are suicidal. Common reasons people reach out include loneliness, depression, anxiety, relationship problems, grief, and life crises. Befrienders centers use a listening approach—trained volunteers provide a non-judgmental, confidential space for people to express their feelings and be heard. This simple act of listening can be powerful for people who feel alone in their struggles.

sections.title: Global Volunteer Network
sections.text: Befrienders centers are typically staffed by trained volunteers who provide emotional support through phone, email, or in-person visits depending on the center. Volunteers receive training in active listening, confidentiality, and supporting people in distress. The volunteer model ensures that support is available even in regions with limited mental health professional resources. Befrienders Worldwide provides training resources and standards to maintain quality across its global network.

sections.title: How to Use Befrienders Worldwide
sections.text: Visit befrienders.org and click on your region to find crisis support services in your country. Each listing provides contact details and information about available services. If you cannot find a service in your country, the website provides guidance on other international resources. Befrienders Worldwide also offers email support directly for people who cannot reach local services. Remember that services vary by location, so check individual center details for hours and contact methods.
